processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Defect-free portions of the 30 kg ingots were homogenised at 1423 K for two hours.

Hot rolling of the homogenised ingots carried out at 1323 K; total thickness reduction of nearly 85% achieved with ~15% reduction per pass. The same schedule was applied to all three LDS grades; the final hot-rolled plate was studied mechanically and microstructurally.

structures.overall_structure: Hot-rolled two-phase/multi-constituent microstructure: austenite (γ) matrix containing κ-carbides, intergranular B2 particles, coarse polycrystalline B2 stringers aligned along the rolling direction (bamboo-like), and a DO3 ordered phase.

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: grain sizes of the three alloys similar, in the range of 5–7 μm after hot-rolling

microstructure_list.region: elongated along the rolling direction, crossing several γ-grains

phases_present.morphology: elongated polycrystalline stringers with bamboo-like morphology

microstructure_list.region: within the γ-matrix grains and along grain boundaries
γ-grains and γ/B2 interfaces after tensile deformation to ε~0.15

defects.type: slip bands (planar glide), inhomogeneous spacing 400–600 nm
B2 stringer cracking (cracks perpendicular to tensile axis)

phase_interfaces.coherence: favourable orientation relationship (e.g. ZA [011]Al||[111]B2) enabling slip transfer
non-favourable (no shared OR); strain accumulation and slip restriction

defect_interactions.interaction_type: slip transfer across favourable γ/B2 interface
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Slip transfer across favourable γ/B2 interfaces suggests substantial load sharing; γ-matrix and B2 grains deform simultaneously near yield as confirmed by nanoindentation and TEM.
Slip transfer was not observed across all γ/B2 interfaces; slip bands stopped at the B2/B2 interface.

defect_interactions.interaction_type: strain accumulation at non-favourable γ/B2 interfaces
defect_interactions.qualitative_or_quantitative_description: Substantial strain accumulation observed at interfaces without OR (hard orientations); KAM and misorientation profiles indicate high local misorientation and promote deformation twinning.
Non-shearable B2 particles increase strength by dislocation pile-up around them; significant dislocation pile-up noted around B2 particles.

interfaces.slip_behavior: Planar dislocation glide dominates, with dynamic slip band refinement; slip bands coarse and inhomogeneous (spacing ~400–600 nm at ε~0.15) in 15Mn5Ni; slip transfer across favourable γ/B2 interfaces, restriction/strain accumulation at non-favourable interfaces; deformation twinning nucleates in reoriented γ grains.
interfaces.phase_evolution: B2 phase fraction decreased from ~15% in the as-cast condition to ~12% after hot rolling at 1323 K, suggesting partial B2 dissolution under hot-rolling conditions.
interfaces.interface_notes: Cracks formed in B2 stringers that exhibit no OR with the austenite grain, indicating that restricted slip transfer at the γ/B2 interface adversely affects the overall ductility; the nature of the γ/B2 interface (favourable vs non-favourable OR) controls strength and ductility.

measurement_conditions.specimen_geometry: cylindrical tensile specimens, gauge diameter 6 mm, gauge length 30 mm
measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Macrohardness: Vickers indenter, 300 N peak load, average of ten readings. Nanoindentation: 5 mN peak load, 500 μN/s loading/unloading rate, 5 s dwell, average of ~50 grains per phase. Tensile specimens cut along RD, and selected 15Mn5Ni samples along TD for in-plane anisotropy; three samples tested per condition.

tensile_properties.stress_strain_curves: True stress–true strain curves along RD and TD nearly coincident ending near 1500 MPa at true strain ~0.15; inset of the yield region (true strain 0.005–0.020) shows no plateau. Tensile test at T = 300 K, ε̇ = 1×10^-3 s^-1.
tensile_properties.strain_hardening_rate: Initial sharp fall in stage III strain hardening followed by a constant (serrated) strain hardening rate just above 1500 MPa; strain hardening exponent n ≈ 0.16 at higher tensile strains (vs ~0.30 for 28Mn0Ni/28Mn5Ni).

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: hardness difference ~HV120 and yield strength difference ~450 MPa (15Mn5Ni higher than 28Mn0Ni)

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: ASTM E140–02; average of ten hardness readings at random locations per sample
characterization_methods.purpose: measure bulk hardness of the hot-rolled alloys
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni average hardness HV375, higher than 28Mn0Ni (HV256) and 28Mn5Ni (HV268).

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: peak load 5 mN, constant loading/unloading rate 500 μN s^-1, dwell 5 s; hardness and reduced modulus via Oliver-Pharr model; EBSD-guided selection of γ and B2 grains; average of ~50 grains per phase
characterization_methods.purpose: measure hardness and reduced modulus of the γ-matrix and B2 grains
characterization_methods.key_findings: γ-matrix and B2 have nearly similar hardness (6.7–6.8 GPa) and reduced elastic moduli 169–172 GPa; B2 grains show pop-in events (first pop-in loads ~50–200 μN) indicating incipient plasticity, absent for γ-matrix.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: LF200 Walter+Bai AG testing machine; cylindrical specimens gauge diameter 6 mm and gauge length 30 mm; elongation measured by punch marks and extensometer
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: room temperature, initial strain rate 1×10^-3 s^-1, ASTM E8M; specimens along RD and (for 15Mn5Ni) TD; three samples per condition; interrupted tests for microstructural evolution
characterization_methods.purpose: evaluate tensile behaviour and in-plane tensile anisotropy
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni YS 1110 ± 8 MPa (RD), 1150 ± 5 MPa (TD); UTS 1260 ± 5 MPa (RD), 1261 ± 10 MPa (TD); elongation 20 ± 2% (RD), 16 ± 2% (TD); minimal tensile anisotropy; no plateau near yield.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: samples polished and vibratory polished with colloidal silica
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni shows two-phase structure with long bright B2 stringers elongated along the rolling direction.

characterization_methods.technique: Electron channelling contrast imaging (ECCI) and orientation imaging microscopy (OIM)/EBSD
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: FEI scanning electron microscope (SEM) with EDAX electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD) detector; EDAX TSL-OIM v8 software
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: large-area 500×500 μm² scans, step 0.2 μm; high-resolution 100×100 μm² scans, step 0.1 μm; GOS cut-off 2° for recrystallised fraction; Σ3 CSL boundaries for twin fraction
characterization_methods.purpose: evaluate grain orientations, phase fractions, grain size, twin fraction and recrystallisation
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni: B2 phase fraction ~12%, twin fraction ~7%, near-random γ texture, banded/elongated grains; B2 stringers polycrystalline with bamboo-like morphology.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Rigaku SmartLab X-ray diffractometer, cobalt Kα radiation, 135 mA current, 40 kV voltage
characterization_methods.key_findings: Confirms formation of B2 phase in the γ-matrix in Ni-added alloys.

characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Tecnai 20T G2 (FEI) TEM operated at 200 kV; twin-jet electropolishing in nitric/hydrofluoric/sulfuric/lactic acid in methanol at 243 K, 18 V
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: hot-rolled and selected deformed tensile samples
characterization_methods.purpose: examine detailed microstructural features and dislocation substructure
characterization_methods.key_findings: Coarse B2 stringers connected across γ-grains with finer B2 at grain boundaries; SAED confirms ordered B2 with DO3 secondary reflections ([011]B2||[011]DO3); cuboidal κ-carbides 10–40 nm; slip transfer at favourable γ/B2 interfaces, slip restriction at B2/B2 interfaces.

characterization_methods.technique: Automated crystal orientation mapping (ACOM) in TEM
characterization_methods.instrument_or_setup: Nanomegas ASTAR hardware and software; precession angle 0.5°; step size 10 nm
characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: deformed tensile specimens of 15Mn5Ni (ε~0.015 and ~0.15); multiple regions examined
characterization_methods.purpose: map phase distribution, orientations and KAM to assess slip transfer and strain distribution
characterization_methods.key_findings: Slip transfer across favourable γ/B2 interfaces (f-B2); strain accumulation at non-favourable interfaces (nf-B2); strain localization around B2 particles/stringers; deformation twins with misorientation ~55–60°.

characterization_methods.purpose: examine fracture surfaces to understand failure mode
characterization_methods.key_findings: 15Mn5Ni shows quasi-cleavage fracture with numerous micro-cleavage facets connected by dimples on a nearly flat macroscale surface; crack-initiation-controlled, triggered by B2 stringers.

characterization_methods.measurement_conditions: B2 stringers/particles and adjacent γ-matrix grains
characterization_methods.purpose: determine phase composition and solute partitioning
characterization_methods.key_findings: Clear solute partitioning between γ and B2: e.g. B2 stringer Fe-11.3Mn-12.2Al-7.4Ni (SEM-EDS, wt%) richer in Al and Ni but deficient in Mn vs γ-matrix Fe-15.2Mn-9.1Al-4.7Ni.

unmapped_findings: Analysed chemical composition of 15Mn5Ni (wt%): Mn 14.7, Al 9.8, C 0.9, Ni 4.1, Fe balance (Table 1).
Reduced elastic moduli of the γ-matrix and B2 phase in hot-rolled 15Mn5Ni are 169–172 GPa (nanoindentation, Oliver-Pharr model).
Nanoindentation load-depth curves of B2 grains showed characteristic pop-in events with first pop-in loads of ~50–200 μN, absent in γ-grains.
B2 stringers in hot-rolled 15Mn5Ni are polycrystalline with bamboo-like morphology and widths in the range 1–5 μm.
SEM-EDS composition: B2 stringers Fe-11.3Mn-12.2Al-7.4Ni (wt%) vs γ-matrix Fe-15.2Mn-9.1Al-4.7Ni (wt%) in 15Mn5Ni; no compositional gradients within B2 grains.
TEM-EDS composition of B2 in 15Mn5Ni is Fe-10.1Mn-9.7Al-8.3Ni (wt%); γ-matrix Fe-14Mn-7.6Al-4.9Ni (wt%) (Table 2).
Deformation twins in 15Mn5Ni at ε~0.15 have misorientation angles of ~55–60°.
Slip band spacing at ε~0.15: ~400–600 nm (inhomogeneous) in 15Mn5Ni, versus ~100–200 nm (uniform) in 28Mn0Ni.
Fracture of 15Mn5Ni tensile specimens is crack-initiation-controlled quasi-cleavage, with micro-cleavage facets connected by dimples, triggered by B2 stringers.
SAED from a B2 stringer showed, in addition to ordered B2 spots, DO3-type secondary reflections with orientation relationship [011]B2||[011]DO3.
κ-carbides in 15Mn5Ni are cuboidal and 10–40 nm in size, with the highest volume fraction among the three alloys; the alloy also has a wide κ-particle size distribution of 5–40 nm overall.
